reviews.t: Works well, but frustrating lack of documentation
reviews.x: Local laws seem to vary regarding the use of shavers by pedicurists. Some places allow them, others don't. Since foot calluses are always an issue for me, a regular pedicure has long been necessary and I prefer places that use a shaver. But this gadget lets me take care of calluses myself quickly and easily, after a shower when my skin is soft. It works like a charm. reviews.t: Great tool to have if you have thick stubborn callus on your feet.

This worked very well at removing the callus by shaving it down then using the other end to smooth it out. reviews.x: Great tool.  Of course it is very sharp and if you have never used one before, be careful as instructed.  I have thick calluses and this removes them nicely. The extra rasp smooths out the edges.

reviews.t: A Safer Way To Trim Callouses.
reviews.x: This callous shaver is an improvement over many other cheaper styles. The handle is thick and easy to grasp, the blade holding area is thicker and stronger, plus there is a plastic safety insert which prevents inadvertent cuts while reaching for the stored shaver. The handle also includes a rasp, with a slide-off cover, which is a better and safer way to eliminate the more lightly calloused areas. reviews.t: Unable to shave thick/normal sized calluses
reviews.x: Doesn't work well. The distance between the blade and smooth surface is so small that the thickness of callus this can shave is so small it's not even worth using. I just use my finger to peel them now because trying to angle this thing in the right manner to actually shave off the callus is so much work, and often not even successful or even possible with the thickness of most calluses. I'm looking for a new callus shaver and am literally throwing this one in the trash.

reviews.x: Another great procuy from tweezwrman. I like the design how it's dual ended and it slides to the side you choose. It's also great to have refills with it and able to order refills. Versus buying a callus shaver over and over. Great product!

reviews.t: Works but has some flaws
reviews.x: I use this on my hands for weight lifting. This was a replacement for an older Tweezerman I had with no rasp. I don't like this version as much. First, the rasp side is really weak so I find it's hardly worth using. Second and more importantly, when switching the plastic guard between rasp and cut modes, it will trigger the blade to spring off the shaver and onto the floor. reviews.t: Works good
reviews.x: I tried a cheap callus shaver from wallyworld and couldn't make a dent with my feet calluses.  This went through them like butter.  The rasp looks and feels real cheap but it works well enough.  It didn't come with ANY extra blades.  Even the  one from wm came with a couple.  Also it doesn't have the feel of a quality tool.  Just throw in a couple blades and I would have given it 5stars.

reviews.t: does the job
reviews.x: The first time I used it I was concerned about cutting myself due to the feedback from other purchasers.  However, I found that the tool worked very well to shave the tough calluses off of my heels leaving them very smooth.  My only negative feed back is that the blade did seem to dull quickly after just a few uses.

reviews.t: Great Product
reviews.x: Surprisingly one of the better purchases I've made on Amazon.  I get pretty large calluses on my hands from weightlifting and pull-ups, this product has definitely saved me from any worries of tearing one of them.  Pretty easy to use and definitely essential for any serious weightlifter, crossfitter or gymnast.

claims.text: Works well at removing thick calluses and smoothing them out, often with the help of the rasp end.
Saves money compared to regular pedicures.
The blade is very sharp and can cut users, so care is needed.
Lacks clear documentation or directions, which some users found frustrating.
Some users found it ineffective at shaving thick or normal-sized calluses.
